name: WBC Ring Of Riches

features.name: Glove frames
features.description: Gloves frame their positions; after a 10-spin cycle frames turn into wilds.

features.name: Sticky glove wilds
features.description: In free spins every glove becomes a sticky wild.

review:
A boxing game made with the World Boxing Council, on 20 lines. Three scatters give 10 free spins, where every glove becomes a sticky wild.

The base game has a neat framing mechanic: each glove frames its spot, frames stay for a 10-spin cycle and then turn wild, and a glove landing on an already-framed spot does something extra. It gives you a reason to watch where gloves land. Medium-high volatility, 3,165x max, 94.96% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
